name: publish_card
description: Publish a card to the learner's cheat sheet (📋 Plonk listek): a basic you just explained, as a compact reference. markdown: the card itself as you write in chat (one bold rule line, a | table | or a - list, two or three examples, at most one 💡 tip; one phone screen), in the learner's base language with the Slovene in **bold**. grammar: the grammar pages it is about (list_grammar's ids): it comes first in their exercises. Publishing again under the same id replaces your card. Returns validation errors instead of publishing if invalid.

grammar.description: Grammar page ids it belongs to (list_grammar)

id.description: kebab-case; default: from the title. The same id replaces your earlier card.

note.description: One-line announcement shown in the app
